shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Cards at rest. Provides ground-plane separation from the gradient surface.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Cards on hover. Amplified to signal interactivity.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Focus ring supplement for heavily emphasized interactive elements.

motion.name: slide-up
motion.purpose: Bottom-sheet and panel entrance from below.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button hover/active, input focus, card hover. Default state transition duration.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.purpose: Button hover transform. Combined with amplified shadow for tactile lift signal.

breakpoints.name: mobile-first
breakpoints.purpose: Primary target. All layouts designed mobile-first.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: max-w-screen-xl on nav bar centers content on large screens.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA — start workout, save, confirm. The most prominent interactive element on any screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: all 0.2s ease; transform: translateY(0); cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #3b82f6; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action alongside a primary button. Uses border + white background.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #1d4ed8; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid #bfdbfe; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); transition: all 0.2s ease; transform: translateY(0); cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #93c5fd; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #3b82f6; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Numeric input for weight, reps, RPE. Always paired with an ALL-CAPS label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4b5563; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #111827; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; transition: all 0.2s ease; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 44px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #3b82f6; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary content container. Floats above the gradient surface. Never nests inside another card.
components.html:
Bench Press

4 sets × 6-8 reps
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 2px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 10px 20px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); } .ds-card-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #374151; margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #111827; margin: 0; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Primary navigation. Fixed to bottom of viewport. 64px height for gym-condition thumb reach.
components.html: TodayCalendar
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; align-items: center; height: 64px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-top: 1px solid rgba(229,231,235,0.5); box-shadow: 0 -4px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 1; height: 100%; text-decoration: none; color: #6b7280; transition: all 0.2s ease; position: relative; } .ds-nav-active { color: #2563eb; } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 48px; height: 4px; background: #2563eb; border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px; } .ds-nav-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; margin-top: 4px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active .ds-nav-label { font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Progressive Overload Hint
components.description: Inline suggestion card shown below set inputs when a progressive overload recommendation is available.
components.html: Hit 8 reps — increase weight to 82.5
components.css: .ds-hint { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; background: #eff6ff; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-hint-icon { color: #2563eb; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-hint-content { flex: 1; } .ds-hint-reason { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1e3a8a; margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-hint-apply { font-size: 0.75rem; background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; border: none; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-hint-apply:hover { background: #1d4ed8; }

narrative.overview:
LiftTracker is a tool, not a product. Every interface decision serves one purpose: let a lifter log their sets with minimum friction, then get out of the way. The visual language takes cues from high-density professional tools — Linear, Raycast — where the data is the hero and decoration is a cost.

The system is anchored by a confident ink-blue as the single authoritative action color. Typography is the native system font stack: crisp, immediately legible, no network request. Cards sit on a neutral periwinkle-to-slate gradient that acts as a physical surface — the app is always elevated above it. Layout density is calibrated for a sweaty thumb between sets: large tap targets, clear hierarchy, no visual noise. Uppercase tracked labels give the interface the feel of a physical log entry — precise, professional, built for practitioners.

This system explicitly rejects the Garmin/TrainingPeaks aesthetic, the neon bodybuilder look, and the Strava social model.
keyCharacteristics: System typography — no loading fonts, no flash of unstyled content
Ink-blue is the single authoritative action color; fuchsia appears only for personal records
Uppercase tracked bold labels — field entries in a log book
Cards lift off the gradient surface via soft shadows
44px minimum touch targets; designed for one-handed use between heavy sets

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Fuchsia is prohibited everywhere except personal record moments. If you're considering fuchsia for a status, a tag, a button, or a highlight — the answer is no.

rules.name: The Gradient Is a Surface, Not a Brand
rules.body: The body gradient functions as a physical tabletop that cards rest on. It must not be extracted for use in components, icons, or text.

rules.name: The System Font Rule
rules.body: No web fonts, ever. Loading a font file during a gym session on 4G is prohibited.

rules.name: The All-Caps Label Rule
rules.body: Section labels and field labels are always uppercase with letter-spacing: 0.05em. Sentence-case labels soften the log-book precision that defines the aesthetic.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: No element that is not a floating card or a CTA button should carry a shadow at rest. Shadows are a state response, not a style choice.

rules.name: The One-Level Rule
rules.body: Cards do not nest inside other cards.

dos: Do use ink-blue (#2563eb) for every primary interactive element — buttons, links, focus rings, active states.
Do use uppercase tracked labels (0.05em) for every form field label and stat caption.
Do size tap targets to a minimum of 44×44px.
Do use backdrop-blur-lg on the navigation bar — it is the one structural blur in the system.
Do use translateY(-2px) on button hover/active consistently.
Do apply dark mode equivalents for every component via dark: prefixes.
Do collapse empty states gracefully — remove the space rather than showing a placeholder.
donts: Don't use fuchsia (#d946ef) anywhere except personal record moments.
Don't nest cards inside cards — The One-Level Rule is absolute.
Don't add a border-left stripe greater than 1px as a colored accent on any card or callout.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). All text is a solid color.
Don't use glassmorphism as a decorative pattern — the nav bar blur is the only permitted instance.
Don't replicate Garmin Connect density: nested sub-menus, redundant chart stacking, settings with more than 6 options visible at once.
Don't add social or community scaffolding to any surface.
Don't use a neon-on-dark color scheme.
Don't add decorative motion — feedback animations only (fadeIn 0.5s, slideUp/slideDown 0.3s ease-out).
